ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B

REASON: This is a substantial creative generation task (3,000-word academic literature review) requiring synthesis and original writing. While both models self-report aversion to open-ended generative work, Whimbrel has stronger overall capability metrics: higher Creative Generation scores (83.4 vs 82.7, though within variance), and notably better benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 62.5 vs 56.2) that suggest stronger analytical writing and knowledge application for academic work. The dissociation between preference and measured capability means either model could perform well, but Whimbrel's higher benchmark profile gives it the edge for complex scholarly synthesis.
